auditor_marc: Hi all - auditor here. For SOC2 evidence we need a single package proving the emergency RBAC escalation on 2024-12-03 (svc-migration -> infra-admin) was temporary and tied to CVE-2024-2100 triage. Need: 1) IAM change record, 2) KMS key ops for alias/redwood-migration (keyId=ff22ee33-4444), 3) vuln ticket MIG-2024-2100, and 4) mapping to SOC control. Can you bundle and post checksums?

isla_ops: Yep. I'll pull CloudTrail events and the GitOps PR (gitops/pr/4780) that triggered the bind. Will include eventIDs.

dan_sec: KMS shows Decrypt + GenerateDataKey calls at 2024-12-03T14:08Z. I'll export the CloudTrail JSON for keyId ff22ee33-4444 and a CSV summary.

infra-bot: Notice: automated detector -> gitops/pr/4780 merged at 2024-12-03T14:06:32Z; detected bind svc-migration->infra-admin.

isla_ops: Splunk query I used (will export redacted + originals):
```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com OR eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/svc-migration" earliest="2024-12-03T13:50:00" latest="2024-12-03T15:00:00"
| table _time, eventName, eventID, requestParameters, userIdentity
```
I'll upload redacted artifacts to s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/MIG-2024-2100/ by EOD.

dan_sec: Packaging plan: manifest.csv (filename, sha256, eventID), mapping.md (SOC control -> artifact), redaction.sh. Originals will be staged in s3://redwood-compliance/originals/MIG-2024-2100/ with restricted ACL.

auditor_marc: Redacted first is fine. Please include originals' SHA256, redaction rules, and manifest HMAC. Auditors need eventIDs to cross-check.

isla_ops: Will post link + sha256 and HMAC when upload complete. ETA ~ 3 hours. :thumbsup:
